Method of Attack: stack-based Buffer Overflow vulnerability allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code or cause Denial of Service (DoS)
sending malicious HTTP requests to the firewall
Impacted Systems: platforms including NSsp 12K, SuperMassive 10k, and SuperMassive 9800
Attack Vector: malicious HTTP request to the firewall
Indicators of Compromise: binary data in HTTP response possibly leaking memory addresses
